units.source_text: 传右卫门坐下后，挑起着浓眉，黝黑的面颊上的肌肉抖动着要笑，私下观察屋里的人们。

en.t: After Den'emon sat down, he raised his thick eyebrows, the muscles in his dark cheeks twitching as if he were about to laugh, and quietly observed the people in the room.

units.source_text: 众人分分回敬，看书的也好，写信的也罢，都分别同传右卫门寒暄，内藏助也殷勤搭话。

en.t: Everyone returned the greeting in turn; whether they had been reading books or writing letters, they each exchanged courtesies with Den'emon, and Kuranosuke also spoke to him attentively.

units.source_text: 其中，颇为滑稽的是堀部弥兵卫，他把没看完的《太平记》放在面前，戴着眼镜打盹儿，

en.t: Among them, the most comical was Horibe Yahei: he had set the unfinished Tale of the Taiheiki in front of him and was dozing with his glasses on,

units.source_text: 这个时候一睁开眼，慌忙摘下眼镜，恭恭敬敬地低头行礼。

en.t: then at that moment he opened his eyes, hurriedly removed his glasses, and bowed his head with great respect.

units.source_text: 看到这番场景，就连间喜兵卫也被他折服模样都笑了，连忙把头转向旁边的屏风，费力地绷住笑容。

en.t: At the sight, even Hazama Kihei laughed at the way Yahei seemed so overcome with admiration, then quickly turned his head toward the nearby folding screen and struggled to hold back his smile.
